simple.meaning: בָּזַז (bâzaz) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to plunder.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 43 times across Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Samuel, and 10 more, beginning at Genesis 34:27. Its contexts include family, family line, flock, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּזַז (H962).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: בָּזַז (bâzaz) / H962 is traced through Genesis 34:27, Genesis 34:29, Numbers 31:9, Numbers 31:32 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), × utterly.
